answer: Because the pearl balance is debited each close, the orchard ledger shows the bleed, and the ocean audit lists every fee. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 14% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. An operator holding 124 idle keys thus pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
